name: Kreativ Broken Image Finder
description: Catch missing images early and keep content quality high across your site.
cardUse: Catch missing images across posts and pages before users see them.
metaDescription: Detect missing image references across posts and pages before they impact trust and UX.

detailItems.title: Broken media detection
detailItems.body: Scans content for missing or unreachable image references that harm trust and readability.

detailItems.title: Content-level visibility
detailItems.body: Highlights affected posts and pages so teams can prioritize high-impact fixes first.

detailItems.title: Maintenance ready
detailItems.body: Supports recurring quality checks as part of routine WordPress maintenance workflows.

items.title: Content teams watching media quality
items.body: This plugin is aimed at WordPress sites where missing images hurt trust, readability, and the perceived quality of published content.

items.title: Teams with recurring audits
items.body: It fits sites that need a repeatable way to catch broken media references instead of discovering them one page at a time.

items.title: Scan, identify affected content, repair the missing assets
items.body: The expected workflow is straightforward: run checks, review affected posts or pages, then fix or replace missing media before the issue reaches users.

changelog.label: Status refresh
changelog.body: Plugin page copy and public metadata were refreshed to align with the current Kreativ WP maintenance positioning.

changelog.label: Release note link added
changelog.body: The plugin page now points to a dedicated update post so visitors can move from the plugin page into concrete release context.
